name: Ghaseti Begum
role: Nawabi court power broker and anti-Siraj faction figure
contribution: Ghaseti Begum was a powerful figure in the Murshidabad court and was associated with factions opposed to Siraj ud-Daulah before the Battle of Plassey.
context: Her influence belonged to the succession and factional struggles within the Nawabi court before 1757. Court politics interacted with the ambitions of military commanders, bankers, and the East India Company.
impact: Ghaseti Begum's position shows that Plassey's political preconditions were shaped by internal court conflict as well as British military intervention.
highlight: Influential Murshidabad court figure associated with anti-Siraj alignments before Plassey.
